title: Affine coordinate transport for specialization restriction
statement: Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $V$ be an affine object of the small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-small-proetale-site]. Suppose evaluation at $V$ takes epimorphisms of set sheaves to surjections and every point specializes into $V\times_X Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Set $A=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ [def-pc-scheme], $I=\ker(A\to\Gamma(V\times_XZ,\mathcal O))$, and let $B$ be the identity object of the affine ind-etale basis over $\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. Evaluation at $B$ takes epimorphisms of set sheaves on that basis to surjections, and every point of $B$ specializes into $B\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$.

source.place: Tag 09AC, first reduction; Tags 09A5 and 03CF for localization

proof.text: Identify the localized small pro-etale site with the small site of V.left. Set-sheaves there are the slice topos at the representable V. Its forgetful functor preserves epimorphisms. Lift a section over the identity of V by the given evaluation property, so that the terminal object in the slice is projective. Transport along V.left.isoSpec and the affine-basis restriction equivalence; its evaluation at the identity is unchanged.

The closed base change is affine with surjective global-sections map. Its quotient by the displayed kernel is its actual coordinate ring, by the first isomorphism theorem. The resulting spectrum isomorphism commutes with the projection. Transport the given specialization by V.left.isoSpec and this spectrum isomorphism, and identify the pullback of the identity with Spec(A/I). Empty schemes give the zero ring and a vacuous point condition.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AC, 09BK and 09BL; explicit localization and counit calculation

lean.statement:
theorem specialization_affine_coordinates
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (V : X.ProEt) [IsAffine V.left]
    (hweak : ∀ (P Q : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (φ : P ⟶ Q),
      Epi φ → Function.Surjective (φ.hom.app (op V)))
    (hspec : ∀ x : V.left, ∃ z : ↥(pullback V.hom i),
      Specializes x ((pullback.fst V.hom i) z)) :
    let A := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
    let I := RingHom.ker (pullback.fst V.hom i).appTop.hom
    let B := AffineProEt.ofEtale (𝟙 (Spec A))
    (∀ (P Q : Sheaf (AffineProEt.topology (Spec A)) (Type (u + 1))) (φ : P ⟶ Q),
      Epi φ → Function.Surjective (φ.hom.app (op B))) ∧
    (∀ x : B.left, ∃ z : ↥(pullback B.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))),
      Specializes x ((pullback.fst B.hom
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))) z))
